description: This file defines a Flutter widget named CheckMark, which displays a circular avatar with an SVG checkmark icon inside it. The widget allows customization of its radius, background color, icon color, and padding.

classes.name: CheckMark
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a circular avatar with a check mark icon inside, customizable via constructor parameters.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, rendering a CircleAvatar with a nested SvgPicture asset representing a check mark.
